description: Fix schedule/cron calendar overflow on mobile (iPhone XR)

userStories.title: Add mobile CSS breakpoints for calendar
userStories.description: As a mobile user, I want the calendar to fit within my viewport so I don't have to scroll horizontally.
acceptanceCriteria: Toolbar stacks vertically (flex-direction: column) on mobile
Toolbar buttons have smaller padding and font-size on mobile
Calendar headers have smaller padding and font-size
Event text has smaller font-size on mobile
Calendar popup/overlay constrained to max-width: calc(100vw - 2rem) and max-height: 60vh with overflow-y: auto

userStories.title: Fix calendar container responsive sizing
userStories.description: As a mobile user, I want the calendar container to adapt to my screen size.
acceptanceCriteria: In ScheduleCalendar.tsx, change min-h-[600px] to min-h-[400px] sm:min-h-[600px]
In CronCalendar.tsx, apply the same responsive min-height change
Add overflow-x-hidden or overflow-hidden to calendar container divs
Calendar still renders correctly at desktop sizes (no regression)

userStories.title: Verify and push all changes
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to ensure all changes are committed and visible in the PR.
acceptanceCriteria: Verify if there are any remaining changes by running git status. If remaining changes exist, commit and push to branch.
